blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Earthquake magnitude directly correlates to energy release.
A single unit increase in magnitude results in roughly 32 times more released energy.
The relationship between magnitude and energy release is exponential rather than linear.
Competitive exams frequently test the exact multiplier (~32 times) of energy release per magnitude step.
Avoid the common trap of assuming a 1-unit increase in magnitude means only a 1-unit or 10-fold increase in energy.
